author: More Perfect Union
description:
In the 1970s the richest guy on Earth had $1.2 billion dollars.

Today Elon Musk has almost 1,000x that, nearly a trillion dollars.

In the 1970s a minimum wage worker made $1/hr. Today minimum wage workers make just 7.25x that.

Producer: @genericartdad
Supervising producer: Victoria Hammett
title: Is the wealth trickling down yet?
